reason: The integrated diff contains real route caching and inlining, but also changes Route::hasTimeWarp to return isTimeWarpFeasible_, while update sets that flag to timeWarp_ == 0. Establish a compatible historical build and independently valid Base/PR route semantics before admission; the title performance claim is insufficient.
